name: Data sharing with Microsoft for ads
plain: LinkedIn shares more member data with Microsoft to personalize ads.
meaning: Profile data, feed activity and ad engagement can feed Microsoft advertising. Applies per account across web and mobile.

android.prompt_ui: Ad settings in the app and on the web

ios.prompt_ui: Ad settings in the app and on the web

data.metric: Profile, feed and ad engagement data

limits.headline: Can use more of your LinkedIn data for Microsoft ads, unless you switch it off
limits.user_action: You open Ad settings in the app or on the web and change the toggle
can: Use your profile, feed activity and ad clicks to personalize Microsoft ads
Share across web and the app for the same account
Be switched off in Ad settings
cannot: Share your data after you switch it off
Apply to other accounts; the setting is per account
Hide the switch; it sits in Ad settings in the app and on the web

story.what_it_is: LinkedIn passes more of your profile and activity to Microsoft to tailor ads.
story.for_you: You may see ads from Microsoft that match your job and interests. A setting in your account lets you turn the sharing off.
story.for_makers: Profile data, feed activity and ad clicks can feed Microsoft advertising, which makes ads more precise and more valuable. It applies per account across web and mobile.

use_cases.example: A software company targets people with a certain job title across LinkedIn and Microsoft ads.
The feed shows you ads based on posts you liked.
A laptop maker shows an ad to people who follow tech pages.
Microsoft promotes a new game to professionals who follow gaming accounts.
A marketer measures how many LinkedIn viewers later click a Microsoft ad.
A recruiter targets ads at people who match a job profile.

story.android_note: The Android app shows the same account setting as the web.
story.ios_note: The iOS app shows the same account setting as the web.

technical_bounds: Excludes data the member set not to be used for ads

linkedin.how: Terms update effective 3 Nov 2025: LinkedIn shares additional data about members in the region with its affiliate Microsoft to personalize ads, excluding data the member set not to use for ads (press summary).

history.change: From 3 Nov 2025 LinkedIn shares additional member data with Microsoft in affected regions

refs.label: Malwarebytes: LinkedIn will use your data to train its AI (Sept 2025)
